/funplay-originals/conceptual/limlet.htm.description: Limlet is a concept play area from our Funplay Originals Conceptual collection, laid out as a cluster of pieces rather than one tower. Yellow arch climbers curve over the space, a red slide runs off the main arch, and a nest swing and spinner seats sit alongside. Because the pieces stand apart, children can climb, slide, swing and spin in different corners at the same time while parents sit close by. The finish is Banana Yellow with Cherry Red. We have not published an age group, capacity or safe play area for Limlet yet, so we size each layout to the site. Share your plot dimensions and photos and we will send a layout drawing with the safe zone marked.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/limlet.htm.spec_paragraph: Limlet is planned per site, so the final specification depends on which arch climbers, swings and spinners you keep in the cluster. Each element gets its own safe zone on our layout drawing, and the swings need clear space in front and behind. We fix the pieces self-standing or grouted to suit your ground. Ask our team for the material and warranty details of your chosen configuration.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions, age group, capacity, activities, skills or warranty line in the fact sheet. Description avoids all numbers; please supply specs.
Current website copy expands MGR as 'Magical Gazebo Retreat', but images show spinner seats (merry-go-round). Copy written from the images.

/funplay-originals/conceptual/witchs-enc.description: Witch's Enchantment is a themed play area built around a story of witches and wizards. The photos show a cauldron-shaped net climber, a lantern tower with slides, a twisted purple climber and a swing frame, grouped into one site. It suits a resort, theme garden or large township park that wants its play area to have a character children remember. The colour scheme is multi-colour, with purple carrying the theme. This is a concept design from our Conceptual collection, so the number of pieces and the footprint are decided with you. Tell us the size of your plot and the ages you expect, and our design team will propose a layout.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/witchs-enc.spec_paragraph: Specifications for Witch's Enchantment are drawn up for each order, because the cauldron climber, lantern tower and swing frame can be combined in different ways. Our layout drawing marks a safe play area around every piece, including the full swing arc. Installation is self-standing or grouted, depending on the soil. Plan for regular checks of the nets and slide joints once the area is open.
flags: Product name in the fact sheet is 'Witchs Enchantment' (missing apostrophe). Copy uses 'Witch's Enchantment'; please fix the page title and H1.
No spec rows, dimensions, age group, capacity, activities, skills or warranty line in the fact sheet.

/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-bird.html.description: Paper Bird is an origami crane turned into a climbing structure, part of our Kagzi collection. The folded body is finished in Baby Blue, with a rope net to climb and yellow stepping pods underneath, and children can also hang from the frame and slide off it. It is made for ages 5 to 12, holds up to 15 children, and needs a safe play area of 17'5" x 14' around a product area of 12'5" x 9'. From a garden path it reads like a sculpture, which many society committees like. Play on it builds body strength, balance and cooperative play. The galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty. Ask us where it would sit on your layout.
/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-bird.html.spec_paragraph: The crane shape is built on galvanised pipe with composite panels and a play rope net, so it stands up to rain and sun outdoors. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Keep the 17'5" x 14' zone clear of benches and lay rubber flooring under the net. Check rope tension and the stepping pods during routine maintenance.
flags: Activities list 'Sliding' but no image description mentions a slide. Confirm.

/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-boat.html.description: Paper Boat scales up the folded paper boat every child has made into a play station for ages 5 to 12. The hull, in Baby Blue and Cherry Red, carries a blue slide, a net crawl tunnel and a climbing net, and a telescope lets young pirates keep watch. Children climb aboard, crawl through the tunnel and slide back to the ground, so play keeps moving in a loop. It takes up to 15 children within a safe play area of 22'4" x 19'7". The skills it builds include imagination, coordination, observation and pretend play. We give a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Send us your site photos for a layout drawing.
/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-boat.html.spec_paragraph: Paper Boat stands on galvanised pipe with roto-moulded and composite parts, and play rope for the tunnel and net. Its footprint is 16'10" x 15'1", so a school courtyard or society lawn usually has room for it. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Inspect the tunnel net and slide fixings regularly, and add impact flooring at the slide exit.
flags: Skill 'Imaginatiom' is misspelt in the fact sheet.

/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-fish.html.description: Paper Fish is a swing set dressed as an origami fish, with orange fish panels on a blue frame and a Mango Yellow seat. One installation photo shows it on a blue river-pattern safety surface, which completes the theme. The design follows a groove idea, so more than one child can swing together instead of waiting for a turn. It is meant for ages 5 to 12. The product area is 10'9" x 8'10" and the safe play area is 15'9" x 14'10". Swinging this way works on hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness. Like the rest of the Kagzi range, its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates carry a 3-year warranty. Call +91 902 830 2266 to discuss your site.
/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-fish.html.spec_paragraph: The fish frame is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded and composite panels. It is installed self-standing or grouted, and the full 15'9" x 14'10" zone must stay free of walkways because of the swing arc. Use rubber flooring under the seat. Bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty, so check them at each service visit.
flags: Capacity '15' is implausible for a swing set; left out of the copy.
Current website copy calls this product 'Twin Fish Swing'. Confirm the name.

/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-frog.html.description: Paper Frog is a spring rider shaped like a folded paper frog, in a dark green Mineral shade with yellow handles. A child can rock it alone by jumping gently on the rear legs or pressing down, so nobody has to push. A friend or parent can join in from the back. It suits ages 3 to 12 and fits small corners easily, with a product area of 2'6" x 1'6" and a safe play area of 6'6" x 5'6". Riding it builds balance and imaginative play. The roto-moulded body carries our 3-year warranty, and the spring is covered for 1 year. Add it beside a larger Kagzi structure and we will mark both on one layout drawing.
/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-frog.html.spec_paragraph: The frog body is roto-moulded and mounted on a steel spring, fixed self-standing or grouted to suit the ground. Leave the 6'6" x 5'6" zone clear on every side, since the rider tilts in all directions. Springs are a wear item with a 1-year warranty, so check the spring and handle fixings at regular intervals.
flags: Capacity '15' is implausible for a single spring rider; left out of the copy.
Warranty line in the fact sheet omits the 1-year cover on springs; copy uses the company warranty for the spring.

/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-mouse.htm.description: Paper Mouse is a crawl tunnel for younger children, shaped like an origami mouse in Pink Pearl and grey. The round front opening leads into the tunnel, and a black wavy tail behind it doubles as a balance path. The teeth-shaped form gives small hands something to hang from. Children aged 3 to 12 can crawl, balance and hang here, which builds balance, imaginative play and cooperative play. The structure is long and narrow at 17'8" x 4'6", so it can run along a boundary wall, with a safe play area of 22'8" x 9'6". One installation used a pink paw-print surface to match. It carries a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a drawing of how it fits your play area.
/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-mouse.htm.spec_paragraph: Paper Mouse uses roto-moulded and composite parts on a galvanised pipe frame, covered for 3 years when installed and maintained as instructed. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Because the youngest children use it, keep impact flooring along the full length of the tail and check inside the tunnel for debris during cleaning.
flags: Dimensions (1740 x 824 x 800 cm) contradict the product area 17'8" x 4'6" (about 538 x 137 cm); the same placeholder values appear on Barrel Barrel and Inframe. Copy uses the product area.
Current website copy calls it 'Mouse Hole'. Confirm the name.
Capacity '15' looks high for a toddler crawl tunnel; left out of the copy.

/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-plane.htm.description: Paper Plane is a double-decker play tower styled as a folded paper plane. Red and purple wing platforms, star-shaped from above, sit either side of a central climbing net, and long Lemon Yellow slides bring children down. The two decks are slightly inclined, so children climb up the middle, choose a deck and slide off as if landing. It is designed for ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children. The tower covers 24'4" x 12'2" and needs a safe play area of 30'4" x 16'2", which suits a long lawn or school ground. Play here builds arm strength, imagination and creativity. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com for a quote.
/funplay-originals/kagzi/paper-plane.htm.spec_paragraph: Paper Plane has the longest footprint in our Kagzi collection. Plan the slide exits away from paths and benches inside the 30'4" x 16'2" zone, and lay rubber flooring where children land. The tower is fixed self-standing or grouted. Inspect the climbing net, deck edges and slide joints at regular intervals.

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/bellatrix.h.description: Bellatrix is a star-shaped geometric climbing frame in our Khel-Khud collection. Its grey and yellow frame has climbing discs, a disc ladder and a climbing net, with a Cherry Red slide on one side. Children can approach from any direction, so no two climbs are the same. Activities include climbing, hanging, balancing, rolling and sliding, and the open frame asks children to plan a route, which builds problem solving and strategy. It suits ages 5 to 12, holds up to 15 children, and needs a safe play area of 21'9" x 19'3". We cover the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope for 3 years. Send us your site size and we will check the fit.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/bellatrix.h.spec_paragraph: The star frame is galvanised pipe, with roto-moulded climbing discs and a rope net. Its 16'3" x 14'9" footprint is almost square, which makes it easy to centre on a lawn. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Lay impact flooring across the whole safe zone, because children climb on every face of the frame.
flags: Subtitle 'Indian Games Play Equipment' does not describe a star climbing frame (applies to the whole Khel-Khud series).

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/candiliciou.description: Candilicious Play is a candy-themed play station with yellow candy panels, a red bead panel, a climbing net and tube slides in red and blue. Rope bridge crossings and stacked net planes give children several ways up, so each child can pick a route that suits their confidence. It is meant for ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children at a time. The station is long and slim at 27'11" x 11'5", with a safe play area of 33'11" x 16'5", so it works along the edge of a society garden. Climbing and sliding here build balance, coordination and spatial awareness. Finished in multiple colours, it carries our 3-year warranty on the main structure. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/candiliciou.spec_paragraph: The panels and tube slides are roto-moulded, the frame is galvanised pipe, and the bridges and nets use play rope. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Keep the tube slide exits clear and check the rope bridge fixings and net knots during each maintenance round.

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/goblin-gull.description: Goblin Gully is built around one long crawl tube that links two slides, with a star-shaped net climber in the middle. A transparent bubble panel lets children inside the tube see out, which gives them the feel of a hideout they have to find their way out of. The listed colours are Mineral and Lavender, and the photos show green and grey domes with a red slide. It suits children aged 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 at a time. Crawling the full tube builds endurance, and finding the exit builds problem solving. The product area is 29'10" x 12'7" and the safe play area is 34'10" x 17'7". Its main materials carry a 3-year warranty. Tell us your plot size for a quote.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/goblin-gull.spec_paragraph: The crawl tube and domes are roto-moulded, mounted on galvanised pipe, with a play rope net climber at the centre. It can be installed self-standing or grouted. Adults should be able to see both ends of the tube, so avoid hedges or walls close to it. Clean the bubble panel and the tube interior regularly.
flags: Skills include 'Space Rescue' (unclear meaning) and 'Crawing Endurance' (typo). Copy uses endurance and problem solving only.
Colour 'Mineral & Lavender' while images describe green and grey with a red slide. Confirm colours.

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/into-the-ch.description: Into The Cheeze is a yellow tower made of stacked cheese slices, with a spiral tube slide wrapping down one side. Each layer is a different climbing step, so children work their way up slice by slice and then slide back down through the cheese. It is designed for ages 5 to 12 and holds up to 15 children. The tower is compact at 13' x 8'2" and needs a safe play area of 18'5" x 13'7", which suits a small society garden or preschool yard. Play on it builds upper body strength, pretend play and creative exploration. It comes in Banana Yellow. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us how it fits your corner.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/into-the-ch.spec_paragraph: The cheese wedges and spiral slide are roto-moulded, supported on galvanised pipe. The tower stands self-standing or grouted, depending on the ground. Because the slide spirals, leave clear space at its exit inside the 18'5" x 13'7" zone. Check the climbing panel holds and the slide joints periodically.

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/itsy-bitsy..description: Itsy Bitsy is a spider-themed playground in Cherry Red. Spider legs form the climbing frame, a hanging bridge crosses to a red tower, and a spiral slide brings children down onto a blue web-pattern surface in one installation. There is also a spider web net, a sideways balancing bar and pretend play panels. It suits ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children. At 36'3" x 9'6", it is the longest piece in our Khel-Khud collection, with a safe play area of 42'3" x 15'6". Climbing, hanging, balancing and sliding here build gross motor skills and balance. The main materials carry a 3-year warranty. Send us your site photos and we will plan the layout.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/itsy-bitsy..spec_paragraph: Itsy Bitsy uses galvanised pipe for the spider legs and tower, roto-moulded parts for the slide and panels, and play rope for the web net and bridge. Install it self-standing or grouted. Its narrow 9'6" depth suits a strip along a boundary. Inspect the hanging bridge and web net regularly.

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/roo-pocket..description: Roo Pocket is a kangaroo-shaped play tower in Banana Yellow for younger children, aged 3 to 9. Children climb into the kangaroo's pouch, where a trampoline lets them hop like a joey, and then slide down the kangaroo's tail. It is compact, with a product area of 12'5" x 5'9" and a safe play area of 18'5" x 9'9", so it suits nursery schools, small society gardens and resort kids' corners. Jumping, climbing and sliding build cardiovascular fitness, balance and coordination. Its pipes, moulded body, laminates and rope are under our 3-year warranty. We can show you where Roo Pocket fits on a layout drawing of your site.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/roo-pocket..spec_paragraph: Roo Pocket combines a roto-moulded kangaroo body with a galvanised pipe frame and a pouch trampoline. Installation is self-standing or grouted. The pouch takes repeated jumping, so inspect the trampoline bed and its fixings often. Lay impact flooring at the tail end, where children come off the slide.
flags: Capacity '15' looks high for a compact toddler tower with a single pouch; left out of the copy.
